name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is a flagship subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Co., listed on the Saudi Exchange Main Market in June 2024; its largest shareholder is named as Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: listed-company parent with founders/VC shareholders per coverage of the IPO; no state stake documented and no human-rights finding found. Present on several Saudi shirts (front/back).
